exact_object: Maximum live nonzero signed support during deterministic construction of the union indicator of clause-falsifying affine subspaces

primary_parameter.definition: K = max_t |supp(c_t)|, where c_t is the canonical nonzero coefficient map after processing the first t forbidden subspaces

signed_recurrence.canonicalization: canonical affine RREF, merge equal intersections, remove zero coefficients

admission_condition.total_cost: O(m*K*poly(d,L)) including basis construction, coefficient bit operations, proof volume and verifier work

strict_open.OPEN_INTERSECTION_CLOSURE: maximum live signed support exceeds the fixed support capability
strict_open.OPEN_WORK_BUDGET: charged producer or verifier work exceeds the fixed polynomial envelope
strict_open.OPEN_CERTIFICATE_VOLUME: serialized or replayed proof volume exceeds the fixed polynomial envelope

basis_contract.required_input: CNF plus affine system or an exact digest-bound replayable C042 basis artifact

verifier_contract.shared_primitives: C042 canonical RREF, provenance, coordinate-form and witness-lifting primitives
independent_checks: SAT witness or UNSAT signed cover
verifier_contract.universal_correctness_method: algebraic induction over the signed recurrence, not enumeration of 2^d assignments

constructive_theorem_target: Affine-coordinate CNF is polynomially decidable with proof-carrying SAT/UNSAT evidence whenever the deterministic maximum live signed affine-intersection support remains within one fixed polynomial capability.

existing_prototype_evidence.limitation: prototype accepts a ready coordinate map and verifies by producer replay; these are not full-admission mechanisms

next_cycle.title: LOCAL_SIGNED_SUPPORT_VTREE_COMPOSITION_OR_STRICT_OPEN
next_cycle.purpose: decompose globally large signed-support arrangements into polynomial local supports joined by proof-carrying separator messages

claim_boundary: C043 covers only global bounded maximum live signed support. Local vtree decomposition, arbitrary CNF, unrestricted Horn-affine composition and P versus NP remain open.
